Rogue Lineage is a fantasy game with roguelike elements. The game revolves around a permadeath mechanic, where each of your characters will have but a few lives before they die forever. **This game has thousands of items and textures so 6 GB+ RAM is recommended**
**Keyboard + Mouse Required to Play**
** Dragon Update Patch Notes: https://devforum.roblox.com/t/ao/4615115 **

Embark on an epic journey through the War Seas, taking part in the conflicts of kingdoms and organizations striving for power. Many will die, but only the strong survive in this harsh, magic-polluted world. 

Conflicts are high as the many kingdoms wage war over possession of Curses, powerful artifacts which grant the user immortality and great power. After defeating great rulers and psychopaths for what you believe is the greater good, you leave yourself questioning what your true purpose in this world is.

Fight against other players, or team up with them and rule the seas as a clan, capturing islands, building castles, and becoming more infamous. Since you were born a mage, you have the option of mastering your magic, or dropping it entirely in favor of fighting styles, weapon mastery, and more.

1184233856.creator: speedydude900
1184233856.description:
A cooperative sandbox zombie survival game with base building mechanics and weapon customization. This game is still in its Alpha stage so expect bugs and other issues. 

controls 
LMB - shoot (repair in build mode) 
RMB - aim (damage in build mode) 
E - melee 
G (5-6) - grenade 
R - reload (hold to rotate in build mode) 
Q - cycle sights 
V - cycle firing mode 
T - toggle/cycle all attachment modes 
F - interact 
`/~ - free mouse/manual attachment mode toggle (open buildable menu in build mode) 
B - enter build mode 
shift - sprint 

Paid access price will lower as development milestones are reached. Your cash will be reset & levels/weapons records will be reduced by 80% once the game fully releases.

3047037061.description:
Game made by bLockerman666 and aamo_s.

Halloween event is out!
Every 5 rounds won, you can vote to play an event round with others.
Beating the event rounds will reward you with event flags (most of the time).
This event is harder than usual, and it's recommended to play with multiple people.

You can customize the board in private servers! (Note that wins don't count in them)
If you don't want to beat the tutorial, you can either skip it temporarily or play in a private server.
Exploiting of any sorts is NOT allowed in this game, and you will be punished for it.

How to play:
The board is divided into tiles, with mines randomly distributed.
To win, you need to step on all the safe tiles, without stepping on a mine.
The number on a tile shows the number of mines around it in a 3x3 area.
Using this information, you can determine tiles that are safe, and tiles that contain mines.
Tiles suspected of being mines can be marked with a flag using the left mouse button.

[How To Fish]
• Hold down to cast your bobber

9910794201.description:
Sonic inspired battlegrounds game!
Join community server below for more updates/news!

📱💻🎮 Dive into the world of Chaos Battlegrounds, playable on all devices.
(PC, CONSOLE, MOBILE)
⭐ Please consider liking and favoriting the game for more updates.

🖥️ Controls:

Left Click - Punch
G - Ultimate Mode
F - Block
Q - Dash
Q (while ragdolled) - Ragdoll Cancel/Evasive
Double Tap W - Run
B - Emote Wheel

Tip: Earn Rings by defeating other players!

⭐ Join our community server to stay updated with exclusive sneaks and exciting news.

9931749389.creator: Delta Quarters OG
9931749389.description:
The original Dungeon Quest is back! Fight through 15 dungeons, slay giant bosses and loot legendary gear, solo or with friends.

NEW: ULTIMATES - beat Voidsbane, the Gilded Skies bonus boss, for 2 new ultimates: Lumenflame's Judgement and Absolution!

- 15 dungeons, from Desert Temple to Gilded Skies
- Huge bosses on every difficulty, up to Nightmare
- Legendary weapons, armor sets and spells
- Upgrade your gear at the Blacksmith
- Hardcore mode: one life, +25% XP and +30% luck
- Trade with other players to complete your set
- Party up with friends or join other players runs

Play on PC, mobile and console.

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite to get notified about new updates!

Officially licensed by Voldex.
9931749389.name: [MODIFIERS] Dungeon Quest Reborn

9934748045.creator: Lucentum Games
9934748045.description:
Welcome to pop and drop, a physics puzzle game where the goal is simple: save the greens and get rid of the reds!

💥 Use TNT, bouncing blocks, ricochets, stacks and other objects to figure out each level
⭐ Earn stars and trophies as you progress
🏆 Climb the leaderboards
🎨 Unlock and equip different skins
🧩 Play Classic, TNT, Bouncing, Stack and Ricochet levels
🛠️ Build your own levels with the Level Editor
🌎 Play Community Levels made by other players or make your own for everyone to try
🎮 Play on PC, Mobile, Tablet, Xbox and PlayStation

New levels, skins, events and other content are added over time!

Inspired by the classic puzzle game Red Remover.

Created by chus_robloxx
9934748045.name: [☃️] pop and drop

🎃 Welcome to Blox Fruits! Become a master swordsman or a powerful blox fruit user as you train to become the strongest player to ever live. You can choose to fight against tough enemies or have powerful boss battles while sailing across the ocean to find hidden secrets.

Current fruits in the game:
Rocket, Spin, Blade, Spring, Bomb, Smoke, Spike, Flame, Ice, Sand, Dark, Eagle, Diamond, Light, Rubber, Ghost, Magma, Quake, Buddha, Love, Creation, Spider, Sound, Phoenix, Portal, Lightning, Pain, Blizzard, Gravity, Mammoth, T-Rex, Dough, Shadow, Venom, Gas, Spirit, Tiger, Yeti, Magnet, Kitsune, Control, and Dragon

FAQ:
-Fruits spawn in the map every hour / despawn after 20 mins
-You can buy fruits from the Blox Fruits Dealer. He restocks random fruits every 4 hours
-More info in the group description
